mapper.select: insert into user_subscriptions ( user_id, plan_id, status, current_period_start, current_period_end, started_at ) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), (select id from subscription_plans where code = #{planCode} limit 1), #{status}, #{currentPeriodStart}, #{currentPeriodEnd}, #{currentPeriodStart} ) returning id::text

select us.id::text as id, us.user_id::text as user_id, sp.name as plan_name, us.status as status, us.current_period_end as current_period_end from user_subscriptions us join subscription_plans sp on sp.id = us.plan_id where us.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and us.status in ('trialing', 'active') and us.current_period_end >= now() order by us.current_period_end desc limit 1
